title: 85 mm-class f/2.35 full-frame all-spherical Sonnar portrait lens

collection.attribution: OpenSci 85 mm portrait lens design study. The Sonnar route began from Ellis I. Betensky's seven-element design.
collection.contributor: OpenSci design studies, submitted through JunLin615

original_publication.reference: Ellis I. Betensky, Figure 8 and Table IV (starting topology)

collection.redistribution: The contributor requested submission to os-optics-lens. A downstream reuse license for the prescription has not been specified.

design.source_reference: 008 Sonnar corner refinement, eight-element balanced-low-tail freeze

aperture_validity.basis: The native aperture plate extends beyond the clear opening.
aperture_validity.satisfaction_basis: Traced pupils and field tests support individual comparable matches under the recorded nominal conditions.

spectrum.sampling_wavelengths_basis: SOURCE_STATED numerical wavelengths preserved from the source native Project
spectrum.wavelength_precision: The original vacuum wavelength samples at full Project precision.

image_format.basis: DERIVED from twice the largest verified real image height. The nominal frame is 36 × 24 mm.

effective_focal_length_mm.definition: Paraxial EFL at the primary wavelength, 587.56 nm

back_focal_length_mm.definition: Paraxial distance from the final modeled optical surface to the rear focal point at 587.56 nm. The finite-conjugate or optimized fixed sensor plane is described by the separate vertex-to-sensor distance.

final_powered_vertex_to_sensor_mm.definition: Last powered vertex to the fixed finite-conjugate image plane

total_track_mm.definition: Axial distance from the first surface vertex to the fixed image plane

engine_check.method: Thick-lens ABCD at the primary wavelength, using the original unit-index propagation convention.

comparison.rule: per quantity: |engine - source| <= atol + rtol * scale

working_f_number.definition: 1/(2 NA) for the axial d-line admitted marginal ray at the finite conjugate

stop_opening_diameter_mm.definition: Diameter of the declared physical iris opening in the native Project.

field.definition: Image-plane field heights of the d-line chief-ray probes

verification.basis: The frozen 0.13.0 finite-conjugate audit checked the primary chief-ray image heights.

materials.basis: Original inline material and coating definitions preserved in project.json

approximations.description: The only Project change is an explicit zero-pressure propagation setting in 0.14.0 so the original 0.13.0 numerical ambient index of one is retained. This is a simulation convention.

solids_findings.message: element OBJ member L2: the N-BK7 between S1 and S2 is 16.9121 mm thick at its edge, 35% of its clear diameter 48.1541 mm, above the review ratio 35%

evidence_notes: The axial object-to-image distance is 1999.999945 mm. The three-line complex OTF uses the documented incident weights and transmitted pupil flux at one fixed image plane.
The independent 512-build holdout used one axial refocus per build. Its simulated P10 values are conditional on the stated error model.
Project solids are valid. The engine reported an informational edge-thickness review at OBJ/L2, 16.91208 mm. Physical hardware and production yield are unverified.
Thirty lp/mm refocused P10 at the two eyes and two corner heights, respectively: 0.697, 0.625, 0.522, 0.458.
